window-manager.title: Window Manager
window-manager.description: A desk of windows that tile, tab together and float, arranged by a plain tree the caller owns.

conversation.title: Conversation
conversation.description: A chat's frame: a scrolling viewport, its content, an empty state, and a button back to the latest. Keeping to the end is the caller's (@hollis-labs/surface-chat's useStickToBottom).

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Markdown as a model writes it, set in the theme; drawn block by block so a streaming message re-parses only its last block.

message.title: Message
message.description: One chat message: the person's in a bubble, the agent's across the width, and a notice line.

prompt-input.title: Prompt Input
prompt-input.description: Where a chat message is written: a growing textarea (Enter sends) and a send button that is a stop button while the agent answers.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: A plain, folded row for a tool the agent called: its name and status; open, its input and result.

attention-layer.title: Attention Layer
attention-layer.description: Rings, a spotlight, arrows and a note over the whole window, at rectangles the caller resolves. Takes no input.

guide-bar.title: Guide Bar
guide-bar.description: A guide's caption, progress and controls (back, next or skip, pause or resume, stop). Draws only; the caller owns the guide.

app-frame.title: App Frame
app-frame.description: An app's frame: optional bar, rail and resizable side panel around the content. Layout only.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Every colour, radius and font a component may name, in light and dark. Import it once, after Tailwind; an app restyles by overriding its variables, never a component.
